lines.t: In a kingdom far away
Where the shadows grew so tall
A humble girl was chosen from the least among them all
She wore a crown of purpose, not of pride or greed
For God had placed her presence there to meet a deeper need
For such a time as this, she stood with faith and grace
When fear was at the door, she saw the Father's face
Her courage lit the darkness, her prayers broke through the mist
She rose to save her people, for such a time as this
Before the throne of power
Her trembling heart would pray
If I must perish I will go
Her faith would lead the way
No sword nor silver promised
Confessed what her God could do
He turned their mourning into joy
And mercy saw them through
For such a time as this
She stood with faith and grace
When fear was at the door
She sought the Father's face
Her courage lit the darkness
Her prayers broke through the mist
She rose to save her people
For such a time as this
God's plan was never hidden
His promise never failed
Through Esther's quiet bravery
His victory prevailed
When all seemed lost and hopeless
His hand was working still
He lifted one who trusted Him
To do His perfect will
For such a time as this
We're called to stand and shine
To walk in truth and mercy
To live His grand design
Like Esther in the moment
We're chosen, loved, and hissed
To change the world with courage
For such a time as this
Outro Music
